body: This finding confuses the fixed companion with the edited target. The pinned three-file order in WireContract.ps1/NATIVE_SEED_FILES is [0] assembly, [1] parts/baseline-5mm.SLDPRT (driving target), [2] parts/candidate-8mm.SLDPRT (fixed companion). Line 281 rejects an unchanged target hash when a different depth was requested. Line 282 intentionally rejects either hash or byte-count changes to index 2 because that companion must remain unchanged. The suggested condition would instead reject every valid unchanged companion and permit its mutation. The exact source passed the real Workstation 5→8→9→7 mm chain, all21 checks, preserving the companion and each prior package; the native README records source e3264e16 and receipt SHA256 f8723f76fc98b63bb63aab22828f3b578ae4a30408b214a66eb48a7b89316829. No source change is appropriate; resolving as a mistaken index interpretation.
